title: Apple opens Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston
title_zh: 苹果在休斯顿开设先进制造中心

paragraphs.en: Apple’s new Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston gives small- and medium-sized businesses direct experience with state-of-the-art equipment, interactive labs, and tools they need to accelerate innovation. CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today opened its new Advanced Manufacturing Center (AMC) in Houston. The center offers free training and educational sessions for small- and medium-sized businesses, giving them direct experience with state-of-the-art equipment, interactive labs, and tools they need to accelerate innovation. The AMC is located within the same Houston facility that builds and ships Apple’s advanced AI servers and will begin manufacturing Mac mini this year. At the center — the company’s second U.S. manufacturing learning site — experts teach participants many of the same innovative processes used to make Apple products. As part of the center’s kickoff event, Apple is proud to host U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick, U.S. Senator Ted Cruz, Houston Mayor John Whitmire, U.S. Representative Christian Menefee, and Harris County Precinct One Commissioner Rodney Ellis, along with other officials and community partners. They are joining Apple leaders and the AMC’s first cohort of small- and medium-sized business leaders for a full day of hands-on training and programming. “In less than nine months, we have invested hundreds of millions of dollars into this Houston facility. We stood up a factory, started production, and shipped the first advanced AI servers off the line. Today, we’re thrilled to open our new Advanced Manufacturing Center, a place where businesses, workers, and students can learn the same innovative processes that we use to make Apple’s most groundbreaking products. And we’re pleased to begin Mac mini production later this year,” said Tim Cook, Apple’s CEO. “We believe in American workers and American ingenuity, and we are moving at an incredible pace because we want to build more than great products. We want to build the future of American manufacturing.” “This opening is an important step in Apple delivering on its promise to bring its manufacturing back to America,” said U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick. “With this Advanced Manufacturing Center, Apple will equip American workers with the skills they need to lead the next generation of technology.” Three people are pictured on the factory floor at Apple’s Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston.
paragraphs.zh: 苹果位于休斯敦的新先进制造中心为中小型企业提供了直接接触尖端设备、互动实验室和所需工具的机会，从而加速创新。 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺——苹果公司今日在休斯敦正式启用其新的先进制造中心（AMC）。 该中心为中小型企业提供免费培训和教育课程，让它们能够直接接触尖端设备、互动实验室和加速创新所需的工具。 该先进制造中心位于休斯敦同一座工厂内，这座工厂负责制造和交付苹果先进的 AI 服务器，并将于今年开始生产 Mac mini。 在该中心——苹果公司在美国的第二个制造学习基地——专家们将向参与者传授许多用于制造苹果产品的创新流程。 作为该中心启用活动的一部分，苹果公司自豪地邀请到了美国 商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克、美国 参议员泰德·克鲁兹、休斯敦市长约翰·惠特迈尔、美国 众议员克里斯蒂安·梅内菲以及哈里斯县第一选区委员罗德尼·埃利斯，以及其他官员和社区合作伙伴。 他们将同苹果领导团队及先进制造中心的首批中小型企业领袖一起，参加为期一整天的实践培训和活动。“在不到九个月的时间里，我们已在这座休斯敦工厂投入了数亿美元。 我们建立了一座工厂，启动了生产，并让首批先进的 AI 服务器下线交付。 今天，我们非常高兴地启用我们的新先进制造中心——一个能让企业、员工和学生学习我们用于制造苹果最具突破性产品的创新流程的地方。 我们也很高兴将于今年晚些时候开始生产 Mac mini，”苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克表示。“我们相信美国工人和美国的创造力，我们以令人难以置信的速度前进，因为我们希望打造的不仅仅是卓越的产品。 我们希望塑造美国制造业的未来。”“此次启用是苹果兑现将制造业务带回美国承诺的重要一步，”美国 商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克表示。“通过这座先进制造中心，苹果将赋予美国工人引领下一代技术所需的技能。”图中有三人在苹果位于休斯敦的先进制造中心的工厂车间内。

At the center — the company’s second U.S. manufacturing learning site — experts teach participants many of the same innovative processes used to make Apple products. previous next Inside the 20,000-square-foot center, Apple experts will share their knowledge directly with participating businesses and entrepreneurs to help accelerate smart manufacturing across America. Curriculum topics will range from classroom sessions on advanced manufacturing principles for final assembly and design considerations for printed circuit board assembly, to interactive workshops that make use of the site’s representative production facility and equipment. As programming expands, the AMC will offer the same hands-on training to local college students, equipping the next generation of American manufacturing workers with critical skills. To mark the AMC’s opening, its first cohort of small- and medium-sized business leaders is spending the day immersed in hands-on training led by Apple engineers, covering smart manufacturing techniques like machine-learning-driven quality control and advanced automation. Participants are learning how to identify and adapt to production challenges in real time, engage with the lab’s holographic table and advanced factory-floor equipment, and gain hands-on experience assembling and laser etching a product themselves. An interior shot of the Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston shows various people seated and working on MacBook, walking, and looking at a holographic table. A closeup of a scale model of the factory floor at Apple’s Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston. Training at the AMC includes learning to identify and adapt to production challenges in real time, as well as engaging with the lab’s holographic table and advanced factory-floor equipment.

Training at the AMC includes learning to identify and adapt to production challenges in real time, as well as engaging with the lab’s holographic table and advanced factory-floor equipment. previous next The AMC builds on the work of the Apple Manufacturing Academy, which opened in Detroit in August 2025 and has already helped nearly 1,000 American workers, students, and entrepreneurs learn smart manufacturing techniques and integrate AI into their production processes. The Apple Manufacturing Academy’s virtual programming also offers flexible, on-demand learning covering topics including automation, quality control optimization, and machine learning with vision, as well as professional development training. Apple announced earlier this year that it will bring Mac mini production to Houston. The company shipped its first advanced AI servers less than a year after identifying a factory site. Since announcing a $600 billion commitment last year, Apple and its American Manufacturing Program partners have invested in designing and producing custom silicon, advanced components, and cover glass in the U.S., demonstrating the company’s long-standing commitment to strengthening the country’s advanced manufacturing sector. Businesses interested in the Advanced Manufacturing Center can sign up to be notified for future sessions. Texas Governor Greg Abbott : “Apple’s expansion in Houston underscores Texas as the epicenter of American industry and innovation. This new facility will deliver the skills Texans need to excel in advanced manufacturing. We thank Apple for its confidence in the Lone Star State.” U.S. Senator Ted Cruz : “Apple’s new Advanced Manufacturing Center underscores that Texas is the best state in the country to do business. We prioritize innovation, competition, and make it easy for employers to grow and thrive. This new facility will drive job creation and directly benefit our communities by giving small- and mid-sized businesses access to cutting-edge equipment, interactive labs, and operations expertise. This project isn’t just great news for Lone Star State businesses, however. It’s great news for Texas working families.” U.S. Representative Christian D.

sents.zh: Apple 制造学院的虚拟课程还提供灵活、按需的学习内容，涵盖自动化、质量控制优化、视觉机器学习等主题，以及职业发展培训。

sents.en: Apple announced earlier this year that it will bring Mac mini production to Houston.
sents.zh: Apple 今年早些时候宣布，将把 Mac mini 的生产转移到休斯敦。

sents.en: The company shipped its first advanced AI servers less than a year after identifying a factory site.
sents.zh: 在确定工厂选址后不到一年，该公司就交付了首批先进人工智能服务器。

sents.en: Since announcing a $600 billion commitment last year, Apple and its American Manufacturing Program partners have invested in designing and producing custom silicon, advanced components, and cover glass in the U.S., demonstrating the company’s long-standing commitment to strengthening the country’s advanced manufacturing sector.
sents.zh: 自去年宣布 6000 亿美元承诺以来，Apple 及其美国制造计划合作伙伴已投资在美国设计和生产定制芯片、先进组件和盖板玻璃，展现了该公司长期致力于加强美国先进制造业的决心。

sents.en: Businesses interested in the Advanced Manufacturing Center can sign up to be notified for future sessions.
sents.zh: 对高级制造中心感兴趣的企业可以注册，以便在将来获得相关通知。

sents.en: Texas Governor Greg Abbott : “Apple’s expansion in Houston underscores Texas as the epicenter of American industry and innovation.

sents.en: This new facility will deliver the skills Texans need to excel in advanced manufacturing.
sents.zh: 这个新设施将提供得克萨斯州人民在先进制造领域取得成功所需的技能。

sents.en: We thank Apple for its confidence in the Lone Star State.” U.S.
sents.zh: 我们感谢 Apple 对‘孤星之州’的信心。” 美国

sents.en: Senator Ted Cruz : “Apple’s new Advanced Manufacturing Center underscores that Texas is the best state in the country to do business.

sents.en: We prioritize innovation, competition, and make it easy for employers to grow and thrive.
sents.zh: 我们将创新、竞争置于首位，并让雇主能够轻松成长和发展。

sents.en: This new facility will drive job creation and directly benefit our communities by giving small- and mid-sized businesses access to cutting-edge equipment, interactive labs, and operations expertise.

sents.en: This project isn’t just great news for Lone Star State businesses, however.
sents.zh: 然而，这个项目不仅仅是‘孤星之州’企业的利好消息。

sents.en: It’s great news for Texas working families.” U.S.

paragraphs.en: Menefee : “I’m excited about the opportunity Apple is bringing to Houston — partnering with small businesses, keeping manufacturing in the U.S., and creating jobs so folks in our community can build a future right here at home. This is a good day for Houston.” Houston Mayor John Whitmire : “Houston is grateful to Apple for this significant investment in our city. The Advanced Manufacturing Center will create local jobs and will continue improving the quality of life of Houston residents. The AMC also recognizes our city as a growing technology hub and solidifies Houston’s leadership in the manufacturing sector of the United States.” Harris County Precinct One Commissioner Rodney Ellis : “I am proud that Apple chose Harris County for this investment. My office has consistently fought to bring good jobs within reach of working people and ensure small businesses — especially those historically shut out — have a fair opportunity to compete and grow. At a time when rising costs are squeezing families here and across the country, this new center can help create pathways to greater economic security. I want every young person growing up in our neighborhoods, every student at a university or community college, and every small business owner working to grow their business to know there is a place for them in the future being built here. Investments like these expand opportunity to ensure that no one is left behind.” Share article Media Text of this article

paragraphs.en: Apple opens Advanced Manufacturing Center in Houston
paragraphs.zh: 苹果在休斯敦开设先进制造中心

paragraphs.en: New training center helps American workers and businesses expand smart manufacturing skills
paragraphs.zh: 新培训中心帮助美国工人和企业拓展智能制造技能

paragraphs.en: CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA Apple today opened its new Advanced Manufacturing Center (AMC) in Houston. The center offers free training and educational sessions for small- and medium-sized businesses, giving them direct experience with state-of-the-art equipment, interactive labs, and tools they need to accelerate innovation. The AMC is located within the same Houston facility that builds and ships Apple’s advanced AI servers and will begin manufacturing Mac mini this year.
paragraphs.zh: 加利福尼亚州库比蒂诺——苹果公司今日在休斯敦正式启用其全新的先进制造中心（AMC）。 该中心为中小型企业提供免费培训和教育课程，让它们能够直接接触最先进的设备、互动实验室以及加速创新所需的工具。 该先进制造中心位于休斯敦的同一座工厂内，这座工厂负责制造和交付苹果公司的先进人工智能服务器，并将于今年开始生产 Mac mini。

paragraphs.en: At the center — the company’s second U.S. manufacturing learning site — experts teach participants many of the same innovative processes used to make Apple products. As part of the center’s kickoff event, Apple is proud to host U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick, U.S. Senator Ted Cruz, Houston Mayor John Whitmire, U.S. Representative Christian Menefee, and Harris County Precinct One Commissioner Rodney Ellis, along with other officials and community partners. They are joining Apple leaders and the AMC’s first cohort of small- and medium-sized business leaders for a full day of hands-on training and programming.
paragraphs.zh: 中心位于公司在美国的第二个制造学习基地，专家们在这里向参与者传授许多用于生产苹果产品的创新流程。 作为该中心开幕活动的一部分，苹果公司很荣幸地邀请到美国 商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克、美国 参议员泰德·克鲁兹、休斯顿市长约翰·惠特迈尔、美国 众议员克里斯蒂安·梅内菲以及哈里斯县第一选区委员罗德尼·埃利斯，还有其他官员和社区合作伙伴。 他们将与美国苹果公司的领导层以及 AMC 的首批中小型企业领导者一起，参加为期一整天的实践培训和活动安排。

paragraphs.en: “In less than nine months, we have invested hundreds of millions of dollars into this Houston facility. We stood up a factory, started production, and shipped the first advanced AI servers off the line. Today, we’re thrilled to open our new Advanced Manufacturing Center, a place where businesses, workers, and students can learn the same innovative processes that we use to make Apple’s most groundbreaking products. And we’re pleased to begin Mac mini production later this year,” said Tim Cook, Apple’s CEO. “We believe in American workers and American ingenuity, and we are moving at an incredible pace because we want to build more than great products. We want to build the future of American manufacturing.”
paragraphs.zh: 在不到九个月的时间里，我们已在这家休斯敦工厂投入了数亿美元。 我们建起了一座工厂，启动了生产，并让首批先进的 AI 服务器下线发货。 今天，我们非常高兴地启用我们的新先进制造中心——在这里，企业、工人和学生都能学习到我们用于打造苹果最具突破性产品的创新流程。 “我们还很高兴今年晚些时候能开始生产 Mac mini，”苹果首席执行官蒂姆·库克说道，“我们相信美国工人和美国的创造力，并且正以令人难以置信的速度前进，因为我们希望打造的不仅仅是伟大的产品。 我们希望塑造美国制造业的未来。”

paragraphs.en: “This opening is an important step in Apple delivering on its promise to bring its manufacturing back to America,” said U.S. Secretary of Commerce Howard Lutnick. “With this Advanced Manufacturing Center, Apple will equip American workers with the skills they need to lead the next generation of technology.”
paragraphs.zh: “这一举措是苹果兑现其将制造业带回美国承诺的重要一步，”美国商务部长霍华德·卢特尼克表示。 “借助这个先进制造中心，苹果将为美国工人提供他们引领下一代技术所需的技能。”

paragraphs.en: Inside the 20,000-square-foot center, Apple experts will share their knowledge directly with participating businesses and entrepreneurs to help accelerate smart manufacturing across America. Curriculum topics will range from classroom sessions on advanced manufacturing principles for final assembly and design considerations for printed circuit board assembly, to interactive workshops that make use of the site’s representative production facility and equipment. As programming expands, the AMC will offer the same hands-on training to local college students, equipping the next generation of American manufacturing workers with critical skills.

sents.en: The AMC builds on the work of the Apple Manufacturing Academy, which opened in Detroit in August 2025 and has already helped nearly 1,000 American workers, students, and entrepreneurs learn smart manufacturing techniques and integrate AI into their production processes.

paragraphs.en: Apple announced earlier this year that it will bring Mac mini production to Houston. The company shipped its first advanced AI servers less than a year after identifying a factory site. Since announcing a $600 billion commitment last year, Apple and its American Manufacturing Program partners have invested in designing and producing custom silicon, advanced components, and cover glass in the U.S., demonstrating the company’s long-standing commitment to strengthening the country’s advanced manufacturing sector.
paragraphs.zh: 苹果公司今年早些时候宣布，将把 Mac mini 的生产转移到休斯敦。 在确定工厂选址后不到一年，该公司就交付了首批先进人工智能服务器。 自去年宣布投入 6000 亿美元以来，苹果公司及其“美国制造计划”合作伙伴已投资用于在美国设计和生产定制芯片、先进组件及盖板玻璃，彰显了该公司长期致力于加强美国先进制造业的决心。

paragraphs.en: Businesses interested in the Advanced Manufacturing Center can sign up to be notified for future sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 对高级制造中心感兴趣的企业可以注册，以便在将来有相关活动时收到通知。

paragraphs.en: Texas Governor Greg Abbott : “Apple’s expansion in Houston underscores Texas as the epicenter of American industry and innovation. This new facility will deliver the skills Texans need to excel in advanced manufacturing. We thank Apple for its confidence in the Lone Star State.”
paragraphs.zh: 德克萨斯州州长格雷格·阿博特：“苹果在休斯敦的扩张凸显了德克萨斯州作为美国工业与创新中心的地位。 这座新工厂将帮助德克萨斯人掌握在先进制造业中出类拔萃所需的技能。 我们感谢苹果对‘孤星之州’所展现的信心。”

paragraphs.en: U.S. Senator Ted Cruz : “Apple’s new Advanced Manufacturing Center underscores that Texas is the best state in the country to do business. We prioritize innovation, competition, and make it easy for employers to grow and thrive. This new facility will drive job creation and directly benefit our communities by giving small- and mid-sized businesses access to cutting-edge equipment, interactive labs, and operations expertise. This project isn’t just great news for Lone Star State businesses, however. It’s great news for Texas working families.”
paragraphs.zh: 美国 参议员泰德·克鲁兹：“苹果全新的先进制造中心彰显了得克萨斯州是全美最适合开展业务的大州。 我们将创新与竞争置于优先地位，并让雇主能够轻松发展、茁壮成长。 这座新设施将推动就业增长，并通过为中小型企业提供尖端设备、互动实验室和运营专业知识，直接造福我们的社区。 然而，这个项目不仅对‘孤星之州’的企业来说是个好消息。 它对于得州的工薪家庭而言也是一个好消息。”

This is a good day for Houston.”

paragraphs.en: Houston Mayor John Whitmire : “Houston is grateful to Apple for this significant investment in our city. The Advanced Manufacturing Center will create local jobs and will continue improving the quality of life of Houston residents. The AMC also recognizes our city as a growing technology hub and solidifies Houston’s leadership in the manufacturing sector of the United States.”
paragraphs.zh: 休斯敦市长约翰·惠特迈尔表示：“休斯敦对苹果公司在本市进行这项重大投资深表感激。 先进制造中心将创造本地就业岗位，并持续改善休斯敦居民的生活质量。 先进制造中心也认可我市作为不断发展的科技中心，并进一步巩固了休斯敦在美国制造业领域的领先地位。”

paragraphs.en: Harris County Precinct One Commissioner Rodney Ellis : “I am proud that Apple chose Harris County for this investment. My office has consistently fought to bring good jobs within reach of working people and ensure small businesses — especially those historically shut out — have a fair opportunity to compete and grow. At a time when rising costs are squeezing families here and across the country, this new center can help create pathways to greater economic security. I want every young person growing up in our neighborhoods, every student at a university or community college, and every small business owner working to grow their business to know there is a place for them in the future being built here. Investments like these expand opportunity to ensure that no one is left behind.”
paragraphs.zh: 哈里斯县第一选区委员罗德尼·埃利斯：“我为苹果选择哈里斯县进行这项投资而感到自豪。 我的办公室始终致力于让好工作触手可及，并确保小企业——尤其是那些历史上被排除在外的小企业——拥有公平竞争和发展的平等机会。 在成本不断上涨、给本地乃至全国家庭带来压力的当下，这个新中心将有助于创造通往更高经济保障的道路。 我希望我们社区里成长的每一位年轻人、大学或社区学院的每一位学生，以及努力发展业务的每一位小企业主都能知道：在这里正在构建的未来中，总有他们的一席之地。 这样的投资能够拓展机会，确保没有人被落下。”

paragraphs.en: Apple revolutionized personal technology with the introduction of the Macintosh in 1984. Today, Apple leads the world in innovation with iPhone, iPad, Mac, AirPods, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro. Apple’s six software platforms — iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS, and tvOS — provide seamless experiences across all Apple devices and empower people with breakthrough services including the App Store, Apple Music, Apple Pay, iCloud, and Apple TV. Apple’s more than 150,000 employees are dedicated to making the best products on earth and to leaving the world better than we found it.
paragraphs.zh: 1984年，苹果推出Macintosh，彻底改变了个人技术领域。 如今，苹果凭借iPhone、iPad、Mac、AirPods、Apple Watch和Apple Vision Pro，在全球创新领域处于领先地位。 苹果的六大软件平台——iOS、iPadOS、macOS、watchOS、visionOS和tvOS——为所有苹果设备提供了无缝衔接的体验，并通过App Store、Apple Music、Apple Pay、iCloud和Apple TV等突破性服务为用户赋能。 苹果超过15万名员工致力于创造地球上最出色的产品，并努力让世界比我们接手时更加美好。
